betterquesting:10.desc:8:
NTM adds its own status effects. Most of them are bad news.

- §cTainted§r - from taint blocks and taint weapons. Randomly hurts you while it lasts.
- §aTainted Heart§r - if a tainted entity is caught in a Tainted Creeper's explosion, the taint turns into this. For an hour you are immune to radiation.
- §cLead Poisoning§r - deals damage over time. You get it from lead bullets and from breaking blocks in air polluted with heavy metals, unless you wear a mask that filters fine particles.
- §cPhosphorus Burns§r - you keep burning, water does not help.
- §cContaminated§r - from fallout, keeps adding radiation.
- §cPotion Sickness§r - after §6Herbal Paste§r you cannot use pills, energy drinks, canteens and injectors for 10 minutes.
- §cButterfingers§r - you keep sliding and dropping things.
- §c! ! !§r - you explode when it runs out.
- §aStability§r - from §6Enteramine Pills§r, protects you from Digamma radiation.
- §aAmbrosia§r - a strange effect from a certain flask. Do not push your luck with it.

Milk removes most vanilla effects but not all of these. The §6Spider Milk§r armor mod clears bad effects for you.
